title: The legend of Vishvamitra, concluded
introduction: Vishvamitra becomes Brahma-sage after a prolonged ascesis that made all the worlds to startle. All gods request Brahma to accord the supreme Brahma-sageship on Vishvamitra as he is cleansed of all mortal impurities, and Brahma accords that highest order on him. Thus Sage Shataananda concludes his narration about the legend of Vishvamitra.
closing: इति वाल्मीकिरामायणे आदिकाव्ये बालकाण्डे पंचषष्टितमः सर्गः
Thus, this is the 65th chapter in Bala Kanda of Valmiki Ramayana, the First Epic poem of India.

verses.devanagari:
अथ हैमवतीं राम दिशं त्यक्त्वा महामुनिः |
पूर्वां दिशमनुप्राप्य तपस्तेपे सुदारुणम्
verses.iast:
atha haimavatīm rāma diśam tyaktvā mahāmuniḥ |
pūrvām diśam anuprāpya tapaḥ tepe sudāruṇam
verses.translation: "That great-saint Vishvamitra then leaving off the snowbound Himalayas on north, oh, Rama, he reached eastern quarter and undertook rigorous ascesis." Thus Sage Shataananda continued the legend of Vishvamitra.

glosses.meaning: snowbound, direction - Himalayan area, northern side

verses.devanagari:
मौनं वर्षसहस्रस्य कृत्वा व्रतमनुत्तमम् |
चकाराप्रतिमं राम तपः परमदुष्करम्
verses.iast:
maunam varṣa sahasrasya kṛtvā vratam anuttamam |
cakāra apratimam rāma tapaḥ parama duṣkaram
verses.translation: "Committing himself to a vow of muteness, oh, Rama, he performed an unexcelled and unmatched ascesis which is highly impracticable for others to perform.

verses.devanagari:
पूर्णे वर्षसहस्रे तु काष्ठभूतं महामुनिम् |
विघ्नैर्बहुभिराधूतं क्रोधो नान्तरमाविशत्
स कृत्वा निश्चयं राम तप आतिष्ठदव्ययम् |
verses.iast:
pūrṇe varṣa sahasre tu kāṣṭha bhūtam mahāmunim |
vighnaiḥ bahubhiḥ ādhūtam krodho na antaram āviśat
saḥ kṛtvā niścayam rāma tapa ātiṣṭat avyayam |
verses.translation: "Even on completing a thousand years, even when that great-saint became woodenly, even many barriers are at full blast, oh, Rama, fury has not entered his heart of hearts, for he stood fast in an unmitigated ascesis on making a firm determination.

glosses.meaning: many, by barriers, blasted [at full blast]

verses.devanagari:
तस्य वर्षसहस्रस्य व्रते पूर्णे महाव्रतः
भोक्तुमारब्धवानन्नं तस्मिन् काले रघूत्तम |
इन्द्रो द्विजातिर्भूत्वा तं सिद्धमन्नमयाचत
verses.iast:
tasya varṣa sahasrasya vrate pūrṇe mahāvrataḥ
bhoktum ārabdhavān annam tasmin kāle raghūttama |
indro dvijātiḥ bhūtvā tam siddha annam ayācat
verses.translation: "On one day when those thousand years of ascesis with the rigorous pledge of Vishvamitra are being completed, and when he started to eat his meal, oh, Rama, best of Raghu's dynasty, Indra arrived there disguising himself as a Brahman and requested for the readily available meal.
notes: This meal is prepared by Vishvamitra alone after a thousand years and such self-cooking of food by the ascetics is called, vaiśva devam, since it is a sacred preparation anena vaiśvadeva ante samāgato atithiḥ svayam upoṣyā api svīya anna pradānena sambhojya iti sūcitam - dk

verses.devanagari:
तस्मै दत्त्वा तदा सिद्धं सर्वं विप्राय निश्चितः |
निःषेषितेऽन्ने भगवानभुक्त्वैव महातपाः
न किंचिदवदद्विप्रं मौनव्रतमुपास्थितः |
तथैवासीत्पुनः मौनमनुच्छ्वासं चकार ह
verses.iast:
tasmaiḥ dattvā tadā siddham sarvam viprāya niścitaḥ |
niḥṣeṣite anne bhagavān abhuktvā iva mahātapāḥ
na kiñcit avadat vipram mauna vratam upāsthitaḥ |
tathā eva āsīt punaḥ maunam anucchvāsam cakāra ha
verses.translation: "Then that godly Vishvamitra willingly gave away all the readied meal to that Brahman, and as no meal is leftover by Brahman-Indra, that great-ascetic Vishvamitra starved himself. Vishvamitra did not speak a little to the Brahman in dissent as he is abided by his pledge of muteness, and he again remained in muteness and breath-control. Like that, he indeed carried on his ascesis.

glosses.meaning: muteness, pledge of, one who is abiding
for him, to Brahman, gave away
food, nothing, remained - Indra consumed everything without any leftovers
to Brahman, a little, not, said
without, breath [with breath-control,] only, he remained

verses.devanagari:
अथ वर्षसहस्रं च नोच्छ्वसन्मुनिपुंगवः |
तस्यानुच्छ्वसमानस्य मूर्ध्नि धूमो व्यजायत
त्रैलोक्यं येन संभ्रांतमातापितमिवाभवत् |
verses.iast:
atha varṣa sahasram ca na ucchvasan munipuṅgavaḥ |
tasya anucchvasamānasya mūrdhni dhūmo vyajāyata
trai lokyam yena sambhrāntam ātāpitam iva abhavat |
verses.translation: "That eminent saint remained without respiration for another thousand years, and then fumes have started to emit from the head of sage who is controlling his breath, by which fumes the triad of worlds looked as if it is searing, and this startled all the worlds.

verses.devanagari:
ततो देवर्षिगन्धर्वाः पन्नगोरगराक्षसाः
मोहिता तपसा तस्य तेजसा मंदरश्मयः |
कश्मलोपहताः सर्वे पितामहमथाब्रुवन्
verses.iast:
tato devarṣi gandharvāḥ pannaga uraga rākṣasāḥ
mohitā tapasā tasya tejasā mandaraśmayaḥ |
kaśmala upahatāḥ sarve pitāmaham atha abruvan
verses.translation: "Then the gods, sages, gandharva-s, serpents, reptiles, demons are puzzled at the ascesis of Vishvamitra, and as their own resplendence is dulled by the ascesis of Vishvamitra, thereby they are marred by this blemish of lowered resplendence, then all of them addressed the Grandparent, Brahma.

glosses.itrans: deva R^iSi gandharvaaH pannaga uraga raakSasaaH
glosses.iast: deva ṛṣi gandharvāḥ pannaga uraga rākṣasāḥ
glosses.devanagari: देव ऋषि गन्धर्वाः पन्नग उरग राक्षसाः
glosses.meaning: gods, sages, gandharva-s, serpents, reptiles, demons
dulled, resplendence - of gods and others
all of them - blemish, marred by

verses.devanagari:
बहुभिः कारणैर्देव विश्वामित्रो महामुनिः |
लोभितः क्रोधितश्चैव तपसा चाभिवर्धते
verses.iast:
bahubhiḥ kāraṇaiḥ deva viśvāmitro mahāmuniḥ |
lobhitaḥ krodhitaḥ caiva tapasā ca abhivar.hdhate
verses.translation: " 'Even if that great-saint Vishvamitra is angered and allured in order to foil his ascetical ascendancy, by all of us and by all means oh, god, he is transcending these lures, angers, and passions by his ascesis.

verses.devanagari:
न ह्यस्य वृजिनं किंचिद् दृश्यते सूक्ष्ममप्यथ |
न दीयते यदि त्वस्य मनसा यदभीप्सितम्
विनाशयति त्रैलोक्यं तपसा स चराचरम् |
verses.iast:
na hi asya vṛjinam kiñcit dṛśyate sūkṣmam api atha |
na dīyate yadi tu asya manasā yat abhīpsitam
vināśayati trailokyam tapasā sa cara acaram |
verses.translation: " 'Now, even an imperceptible imperfection does not really appear in him, but if his heartfelt desire is not meted out, he will devastate the triad of worlds with his ascetic power.

verses.devanagari:
व्याकुलाश्च दिशः सर्वा न च किंचित् प्रकाशते
सागराः क्षुभिताः सर्वे विशीर्यन्ते च पर्वताः |
verses.iast:
vyākulāḥ ca diśaḥ sarvā na ca kiñcit prakāśate
sāgarāḥ kṣubhitāḥ sarve viśīryante ca parvatāḥ |
verses.translation: " 'All the directions are all tumultuous, all the oceans are tempestuous, and all the mountains are eruptive, and nothing is bright.

verses.devanagari:
प्रकंपते च वसुधा वायुर्वातीह संकुलः
ब्रह्मन्न प्रतिजानीमो नास्तिको जायते जनः |
verses.iast:
prakampate ca vasudhā vāyuḥ vāti iha saṅkulaḥ
brahman napratijānīmo nāstiko jāyate janaḥ |
verses.translation: " 'The earth is highly tremulous, air is gusting turbulently, oh, Brahma, people tend to become non-theistic and we do not know what to do.

glosses.meaning: not, towards, we know - we don't know what to do
not, theistic, they tend to become.

verses.devanagari:
सम्मूढमिव त्रैलोक्यं संप्रक्षुभितमानसम्
भास्करो निष्प्रभश्चैव महर्षेस्तस्य तेजसा |
verses.iast:
sammūḍham iva trailokyam samprakśubhita mānasam
bhāskaro niṣprabhaḥ caiva maharṣeḥ tasya tejasā |
verses.translation: " 'All the beings in the triad of the worlds are very highly perturbed at their senses and they are as though stupefied, and when juxtaposed the sun is lustreless before the resplendence of that great sage.

glosses.meaning: his, of grate sage, by resplendence

verses.devanagari:
बुद्धिं न कुरुते यावन्नाशे देव महामुनिः
तावत्प्रसादो भगवानग्निरूपो महाद्युतिः |
verses.iast:
buddhim na kurute yāvat nāśe deva mahāmuniḥ
tāvat prasādo bhagavān agni rūpo mahādyutiḥ |
verses.translation: " 'Oh, God, great saint Vishvamitra turned out to be the embodiment of Fire-god, and before that great-resplendent and most reverential sage makes up his mind for total destruction of all worlds he is to be placated.

glosses.meaning: in total destruction - of all worlds
mind, not, going to make up

verses.devanagari:
कालाग्निना यथा पूर्वं त्रैलोक्यं दह्यतेऽखिलम्
देवराज्यं चिकीर्षेत दीयतामस्य यन्मतम् |
verses.iast:
kāla agninā yathā pūrvam trailokyam dahyate akhilam
deva rājyam cikīrṣeta dīyatām asya yat matam |
verses.translation: " 'As to how the End-Time Fire entirely blazed away the triad of worlds previously, now this sage may do likewise, hence whatever is his predilection that may be given to him, even if he wants to become the potentate on the realm of gods.' Thus, all gods appealed to Brahma

glosses.meaning: previously, by End-Time, Fire, as to how, blazed away
of gods, realm, wants to do [be potentate of]

verses.devanagari:
ततः सुरगणाः सर्वे पितामहपुरोगमाः
विश्वामित्रं महात्मानं वाक्यं मधुरमब्रुवन् |
verses.iast:
tataḥ sura gaṇāḥ sarve pitāmaha purogamāḥ
viśvāmitram mahātmānam vākyam madhuram abruvan |
verses.translation: "Then all the assemblages of gods keeping the Grandparent Brahma in their forefront appeared before that great souled Vishvamitra and said this harmonious word.

glosses.meaning: to great souled one, to Vishvamitra

verses.devanagari:
ब्रह्मर्षे स्वागतं तेऽस्तु तपसा स्म सुतोषिताः
ब्राह्मण्यं तपसोग्रेण प्राप्तवानसि कौशिक |
verses.iast:
brahmarṣe svāgatam te astu tapasā sma su toṣitāḥ
brāhmaṇyam tapasā ugreṇa prāptavān asi kauśika |
verses.translation: " 'Oh, Brahma-sage, you are welcome. We are much contented with your ascesis. Oh, Kaushika, you have achieved Bahaman-hood by your rigorous ascesis.

glosses.meaning: to you, welcome, let there be [you are welcome]
by ascesis, much, contented, we are

verses.devanagari:
दीर्घमायुश्च ते ब्रह्मन् ददामि समरुद्गणः
स्वस्ति प्राप्नुहि भद्रं ते गच्छ सौम्य यथासुखम् |
verses.iast:
dīrgham āyuḥ ca te brahman dadāmi sa marud gaṇaḥ
svasti prāpnuhi bhadram te gaccha sauṃya yathā sukham |
verses.translation: " 'Along with the assemblages of Marut-Wind-gods, I bestow upon you a long life. Let blissfulness betide you. You be safe. Oh, gentle sage, you may take leave as you please.' Thus, Brahma said to Vishvamitra.

glosses.meaning: to you, safeness will be there

verses.devanagari:
पितामहवचः श्रुत्वा सर्वेषां त्रिदिवौकसाम्
कृत्वा प्रणामं मुदितो व्याजहार महामुनिः |
verses.iast:
pitāmaha vacaḥ śrutvā sarveṣām tridiva okasām
kṛtvā praṇāmam mudito vyājahāra mahāmuniḥ |
verses.translation: "On hearing the word of Grandparent Brahma and the other residents of heaven, and on paying good devoirs to all of them that great saint cheerfully said.

verses.devanagari:
ब्राह्मण्यं यदि मे प्राप्तं दीर्घमायुस्तथैव च
ओंकारोऽथ वषट्कारो वेदाश्च वरयन्तु माम् |
verses.iast:
brāhmaṇyam yadi me prāptam dīrgham āyuḥ tathaiva ca
AUṃ kāro atha vaṣaṭ kāro vedāḥ ca varayantu mām |
verses.translation: " 'If Brahman-hood and eternality have befallen on me, let the quintessence of AUM and vaSat syllables, and even all Veda-s patronise me.

glosses.meaning: long, life [eternality,] also - if I got them

verses.devanagari:
क्षत्र वेदविदां श्रेष्ठो ब्रह्मवेदविदामपि
ब्रह्मपुत्रो वसिष्ठो मामेवं वदतु देवताः |
यद्ययं परमः कामः कृतो यान्तु सुरर्षभाः
verses.iast:
kṣatra vedavidām śreṣṭho brahma vedavidām api
brahma putro vasiṣṭho mām evam vadatu devatāḥ |
yadi ayam paramaḥ kāmaḥ kṛto yāntu surarṣabhāḥ
verses.translation: " 'Oh, gods, he who is the outstanding one among the geniuses of kingcraft, and among the scholars of Veda-s as well, even that Vashishta, the brainchild of Brahma, shall acknowledge me in this way as Brahma-sage. Oh, the best gods, you may take leave if you can effectuate this ultimate yearning of mine.' Thus Vishvamitra requested the gods.

glosses.meaning: Brahman, knowledge, among knowers [scholars of Veda-s,] even

verses.devanagari:
ततः प्रसादितो देवैर्वसिष्ठो जपतां वरः |
सख्यं चकार ब्रह्मर्षिरेवमस्त्विति चाब्रवीत्
verses.iast:
tataḥ prasādito devaiḥ vasiṣṭho japatām varaḥ |
sakhyam cakāra brahmarṣiḥ evam astu iti ca abravīt
verses.translation: "Then the best one among meditators Vashishta has come over there when the gods besought him to come, and he made friendship with Vishvamitra. He also said in this way to Vishvamitra, 'you are a Brahma-sage.'

glosses.meaning: then, by gods, one who is besought - Vashishta

verses.devanagari:
ब्रह्मर्षिस्त्वं न संदेहः सर्वं संपद्यते तव |
इत्युक्त्वा देवताश्चापि सर्वा जग्मुर्यथागतम्
verses.iast:
brahmarṣiḥ tvam na sandehaḥ sarvam sampadyate tava |
iti uktvā devatāḥ ca api sarvā jagmuḥ yathā āgatam
verses.translation: "No doubt, you are a Brahma-sage and everything will accrue to you in accordance with the sublimity of this sageship,' and when Vashishta said so to Vishvamitra, all the gods have gone away as they have come.

glosses.meaning: to you, everything, will accrue - in accordance with this sageship
as, they have come, went away.

verses.devanagari:
विश्वामित्रोऽपि धर्मात्मा लब्ध्वा ब्राह्मण्यमुत्तमम् |
पूजयामास ब्रह्मर्षिं वसिष्ठं जपतां वरम्
verses.iast:
viśvāmitro api dharmātmā labdhvā brāhmaṇyam uttamam |
pūjayāmāsa brahmarṣim vasiṣṭham japatām varam
verses.translation: "On getting his Brahman-hood even the virtue-souled Vishvamitra started to reverence the supreme among meditators and his counterpart Brahma-sage, namely Vashishta.

glosses.meaning: Brahma-sage, among meditators, the best one, at Vashishta

verses.devanagari:
कृतकामो महीं सर्वां चचार तपसि स्थितः |
एवं त्वनेन ब्राह्मण्यं प्राप्तं राम महात्मना
verses.iast:
kṛta kāmo mahīm sarvām cacāra tapasi sthitaḥ |
evam tu anena brāhmaṇyam prāptam rāma mahātmanā
verses.translation: "When his aim is effectuated Vishvamitra ambled all over the earth abiding in ascesis, and oh, Rama, this great souled sage Vishvamitra achieved Brahman-hood in this way.

glosses.meaning: effectuated, aim - whose aim is effectuated

verses.devanagari:
एष राम मुनिश्रेष्ठ एष विग्रहवान् तपः |
एष धर्मः परो नित्यं वीर्यस्यैष परायणम्
verses.iast:
eṣa rāma muni śreṣṭha eṣa vigrahavān tapaḥ |
eṣa dharmaḥ paro nityam vīryasya eṣa parāyaṇam
verses.translation: "Oh, Rama, he is the best saint, he is the embodiment of ascesis, he is always obliged with righteousness, and he is the stronghold for fortitude."

glosses.meaning: he is, always, in righteousness, obliged with
he is, for fortitude, dwelling house stonghold.

verses.devanagari:
एवमुक्त्वा महातेजा विरराम द्विजोत्तमः |
शतानंदवचः श्रुत्वा रामलक्ष्मणसंनिधौ
जनकः प्रांजलिर्वाक्यमुवाच कुशिकात्मजम् |
verses.iast:
evam uktvā mahātejā virarāma dvijottamaḥ |
śatānanda vacaḥ śrutvā rāma lakṣmaṇa saṃnidhau
janakaḥ prāñjaliḥ vākyam uvāca kuśikāatmajam |
verses.translation: On narrating the legend of Vishvamitra in this way that best Brahman and great-resplendent Sage Shataananda took respite. And on listening the narration of Sage Shataananda said in the presence of Rama and Lakshmana, king Janaka said this sentence to Kushika's son, Vishvamitra, with suppliantly adjoined palms.

glosses.meaning: that way, on saying, took respite
Rama, Lakshmana, in the presence of

verses.devanagari:
धन्योऽस्म्यनुगृहीतोऽस्मि यस्य मे मुनिपुंगव
यज्ञं काकुत्स्थसहितः प्राप्तवानसि कौशिक |
verses.iast:
dhanyo asmi anugṛhīto asmi yasya me munipuṅgava
yajñam kākutstha sahitaḥ prāptavān asi kauśika |
verses.translation: "Oh, eminent sage Vishvamitra, you happened to be here at this Vedic-ritual which is conducted by me, oh, Kaushika, that too, along with Rama and Lakshmana, the legatees of Kakutstha, thereby I am fortunate, I am much obliged. [31b, 32a]

verses.devanagari:
पावितोऽहं त्वया ब्रह्मन् दर्शनेन महामुने
गुणा बहुविधाः प्राप्तास्तव संदर्शनान्मया |
verses.iast:
pāvito aham tvayā brahman dar.hśanena mahāmune
guṇā bahu vidhāḥ prāptāḥ tava sandarśanāt mayā |
verses.translation: "Oh, Brahman, I stand consecrated just by your graceful glance, and oh, great saint, I reckon that I have achieved many boons just glancing at you.

glosses.meaning: by you, when see - by your graceful glance
many, kinds, of attributes [boons,] achieved [by me.]

verses.devanagari:
विस्तरेण च वै ब्रह्मन् कीर्त्यमानं महत्तपः
श्रुतं मया महातेजो रामेण च महात्मना |
verses.iast:
vistareṇa ca vai brahman kīrtyamānam mahattapaḥ
śrutam mayā mahātejo rāmeṇa ca mahātmanā |
verses.translation: "Oh, great-resplendent Brahman, myself and the noble souled Rama have heard about your great ascesis when Sage Shataananda extolled it comprehensively.

verses.devanagari:
सदस्यैः प्राप्य च सदः श्रुतास्ते बहवो गुणाः
अप्रमेया तपस्तुभ्यमप्रमेयं च ते बलम् |
अप्रमेया गुणाश्चैव नित्यं ते कुशिकात्मज
verses.iast:
sadasyaiḥ prāpya ca sadaḥ śrutāḥ te bahavo guṇāḥ
aprameyam tapaḥ tubhyam aprameyam ca te balam |
aprameyā guṇāḥ caiva nityam te kuśikātmaja
verses.translation: "The congregationalists available in this Vedic-ritual congregation have also heard about your numerous endowments. Inestimable is your ascesis, infinite is your power, and oh, son of Kushika, your talents are everlastingly invaluable.

glosses.meaning: by congregationalists, congregation, [who have] come - who are available in

verses.devanagari:
तृप्तिराश्चर्यभूतानां कथानां नास्ति मे विभो |
कर्मकालो मुनिश्रेष्ठ लम्बते रविमण्डलम्
verses.iast:
tṛptiḥ āścarya bhūtānām kathānām na asti me vibho |
karma kālo muni śreṣṭha lambate ravi maṇḍalam
verses.translation: "Oh, lord, there is no contentment to me while listening to your wondrous narratives, but oh nobleman, time for vespertine ritual is fast approaching as sun's sphere is dangling westward.

glosses.meaning: to me, contentment, not, is there

verses.devanagari:
श्वः प्रभाते महातेजो द्रष्टुमर्हसि मां पुनः |
स्वागतं जपतां श्रेष्ठ मामनुज्ञातुमर्हसि
verses.iast:
śvaḥ prabhāte mahātejo draṣṭum ar.hhasi mām punaḥ |
svāgatam japatām śreṣṭha mām anujñātum ar.hhasi
verses.translation: "Oh, great-resplendent sage, it will be apt of you to see me tomorrow. Oh, best meditator, it will be apt of you to permit me to leave for now." Thus Janaka sought leave from Vishvamitra.

glosses.meaning: me, again to see, apt of you
me [to leave,] to permit, apt of you.

verses.devanagari:
एवमुक्तो मुनिवरः प्रशस्य पुरुषर्षभम् |
विससर्जाशु जनकं प्रीतं प्रीतिमांस्तदा
verses.iast:
evam ukto munivaraḥ praśasya puruṣarṣabham |
visasarja āśu janakam prītam prītimān tadāa
verses.translation: When he is spoken in that way, the best saint Vishvamitra is pleased at heart, and praising Janaka, who too is pleased to meet the sage, immediately bid farewell to the best one among men, namely Janaka.

glosses.meaning: that way, who is spoken to [Vishvamitra,] saint, the best
pleased, to the best one among men, to Janaka

verses.devanagari:
एवमुक्त्वा मुनिश्रेष्ठं वैदेहो मिथिलाधिपः |
प्रदक्षिणं चकाराशु सोपाध्यायः सबांधवः
verses.iast:
evam uktvā muni śreṣṭham vaideho mithilā adhipaḥ |
pradakṣiṇam cakāra āśu sa upādhyāyaḥ sa bāndhavaḥ
verses.translation: This way on saying to the best saint, the king of Mithila and the legatee of Videha lineage, immediately performed circumambulations along with his teachers and relatives to Vishvamitra in veneration.

glosses.meaning: to saint, the best, in this way, on saying

verses.devanagari:
विश्वामित्रोऽपि धर्मात्मा सहरामः सलक्ष्मणः |
स्वं वासमभिचक्राम पूज्यमानो महर्षिभिः
verses.iast:
viśvāmitro api dharmātmā saha rāmaḥ sa lakṣmaṇaḥ |
svam vāsam abhicakrāma pūjyamāno mahar.hṣibhiḥ
verses.translation: Even that virtue souled Vishvamitra started towards his own camp along with Rama and Lakshmana, while being venerated by great sages who are available in the ritual-hall.
